theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (F : Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid k)) (g : Euclid k → ℤ) (G : Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) A → (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K G) → (∀ u ∈ A, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) = t • F u ∧ (fun a => fderiv ℝ G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = (Fin.cons (F u) (t • fun b => fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P)) → Measurable (fun z : Euclid (k + 1) => g (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)))) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z : Euclid (k + 1) => (g (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) : ℝ)) {z : Euclid (k + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid k) ∈ A} ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1), Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → ∫ z in {z : Euclid (k + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid k) ∈ A}, (g (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))) : ℝ) * ω (G z) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G z (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ u in A, (g u : ℝ) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ k * ω (t • F u) (Fin.cons (F u) (fun b => fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))
